scope: United States canonical primary site-resolved observed charging-session families. Overlapping network/year/site summary layers, retired duplicates, non-spatial rows, modeled utilization, charger inventory and AADT are excluded.

source_families.evidence_class: official observed sessions plus bounded address geocoding for spatial lookup
NYC DOT observed monthly session aggregates
source_families.note: Only coordinate-resolved primary monthly rows count here. Alternate site/network summary views are excluded to prevent double counting.

source_families.evidence_class: official observed monthly DC fast-charging aggregate
source_families.note: Block-level spatial anchor only. Do not represent it as exact charger GPS.

evidence_rules: Observed charging_sessions_count is required for session coverage.
Coordinates or a geocoded physical site are required for RIVET nearby-session lookup.
Inventory, AADT, availability and modeled utilization never become observed sessions.
Overlapping summary layers are excluded from the aggregate total.
Retired duplicate rows and confidence_pct <= 0 are excluded.
